command:
printf 'GRAPHICS
'; systemctl is-active init_display.service; pidof weston; cat /sys/class/drm/card0-DSI-1/enabled; printf 'BRIDGE IRQ
'; grep -i lt9611 /proc/interrupts || true; printf 'KERNEL
'; journalctl -b -k --since '-3 minutes' --no-pager | grep -Ei '9611|drm|hdmi|dsi' | tail -n 55; printf 'DISPLAY LOG
'; tail -n 60 /logcat
